sections.heading: Initial dialogue
paragraphs: First Spear Dehvad Ahai, <Character name>. How's your luck been lately? Mine's improved greatly since you helped clear out those corsair raiders. Of course, we can't rely on luck to get us through every scrape. A seasoned soldier never ignores his training. In fact, those are Kormir's orders. All new recruits must hone their primary skills until they reach level five and then begin a rigorous training regimen in a secondary profession. We've all got to be at our best if we hope to meet the challenges that face Elona. So, come talk to me again when you reach level five and I'll get you started on your training.

Accept: "I'll be back in no time!" Decline: "How about we play cards instead?" Ask: "The best way to hone your primary skills is to help some of the local people with their problems. But come back as soon as you reach level five. You don't want Kormir to see you slacking on your Sunspear duties."

Quest information[edit]

Requirements[edit]

  • Elonian (Nightfall) character

Objectives[edit]

  • Speak to Second Spear Binah to enter Kamadan.
  • Hone your skills by reaching level 5.
  • See First Spear Dehvad for your reward.

Reward[edit]

  • 500 Experience
  • 250 Gold
  • 10 Sunspear Promotion Points

Walkthrough[edit]

Complete quests or defeat enemies until you reach level 5. Talk to First Spear Dehvad for your reward.

Dialogue[edit]

Initial dialogue[edit]

First Spear Dehvad
Ahai, <Character name>. How's your luck been lately? Mine's improved greatly since you helped clear out those corsair raiders. Of course, we can't rely on luck to get us through every scrape. A seasoned soldier never ignores his training. In fact, those are Kormir's orders. All new recruits must hone their primary skills until they reach level five and then begin a rigorous training regimen in a secondary profession. We've all got to be at our best if we hope to meet the challenges that face Elona. So, come talk to me again when you reach level five and I'll get you started on your training.
 Accept: "I'll be back in no time!"
 Decline: "How about we play cards instead?"
 Ask: "The best way to hone your primary skills is to help some of the local people with their problems. But come back as soon as you reach level five. You don't want Kormir to see you slacking on your Sunspear duties."

Reward dialogue[edit]

First Spear Dehvad
Back so soon? Wow, Koss was right about you. Don't tell him I told you, but Koss called you the "Rising star of the new Order." Well, we'd better get you started on your basic training.

Notes[edit]

  • If you map travel to Kamadan or if you received the quest from First Spear Dehvad in Kamadan, your compass will have a starburst to talk to Binah in Kamadan, to go into Churrhir Fields and then talk to Binah again to go back into Kamadan. Your world map will also say to go back into Churrhir Fields.
